propositions: Over-triggering SHA-drift invalidation without declared file_impact affects 21% of re-reviews on byte-identical material; scoping the fail-safe to read-set and cited paths reduces false positives while preserving safety.

The signed manifest must record normalized read paths from distinct_fetches (tool=read_file only), applying root resolution, containment checks, POSIX normalization, existence filtering, and deduplication.

Currency reuses ADR-0002 content-hash machinery to compose read-set with blast-radius entries (criteria routing, rebar.toml, reviewers, gates) only when the pre-existing dependency set is empty and scope is undeclared.
Glob patterns in the dependency set are handled via membership digest (sha256 of sorted matched files) to detect file addition/deletion, while plain paths use standard file hashing.
Unverifiable read-set, missing field on pre-change attestations, and expansion failures fall back to invalidate-on-any-change (empty dependency set behavior).
The currency-basis field (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe) is recorded in the signed manifest and reported by plan_review_status and review-plan --status.
